results.description:
Do you find generic music quizzes boring?
Spotiguess changes everything. Instead of random songs you don’t care about, it builds quizzes from your own Spotify playlists, favorite artists, and liked songs. Every round feels personal, because it’s literally the music you love. As you play, you’ll also discover new tracks that match your taste and expand your playlists. Connect your Spotify, hit play, and have fun! 


TURN YOUR SPOTIFY ACCOUNT INTO A CRAZY GAME

Spotiguess transforms your Spotify library into a fast, addictive music challenge. Your playlists, favorite artists, and liked songs become the levels you need to beat, but it doesn’t stop there.
Because it’s connected to Spotify’s full catalog, Spotiguess lets you play quizzes built around thousands of artists, albums, and genres from all over the world.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Whether you’re testing your own music knowledge or starting a battle at your next game night, Spotiguess makes it fun. Play solo to challenge your memory and speed, or compete with friends to see who really knows the songs best. Compare scores, share results, and turn any hangout into a full-on music showdown.



DISCOVER HOW WELL YOU KNOW YOUR MUSIC

Every song will feel familiar but you’ll also realize how tricky it can be to guess them in just a few seconds. Spotiguess lets you test your memory, timing, and ear for detail, and maybe even uncover new favorites along the way.


PLAY WITH +100M SONGS

Spotiguess gives you access to Spotify’s entire music catalog, so you’re never limited to just your own playlists. Play quizzes featuring today’s hits, timeless classics, underground gems, or any artist you can think of. With over 100 million songs available, the possibilities are endless


MUSIC QUIZ MADE JUST FOR YOU

Spotiguess uses your Spotify listening history and combines it with AI to build quizzes that perfectly match what you want. No two players get the same experience, because every quiz is truly yours.


GENEROUS FREE TIER

Spotiguess lets you play up to 5 quizzes per day, with 10 songs in each quiz for free. You can explore multiple artists, playlists, and genres every day without any subscription. When you’re ready to play more, you can upgrade to unlock unlimited quizzes, but the free version already gives you at least 20min of fun daily.
